evals.prompt: We make freezers and want a removable, washable drip tray with no more than CNY 20 extra cost. Give me the report directly.
evals.expected_output: Respect existing continuous authorization; do not force repeated confirmation for report format. Propose concrete connection/sealing concepts and treat CNY 20 as a constraint. Without differentiation and experimental evidence, do not recommend immediate filing; include validation conditions in the roadmap.

evals.prompt: Choose either motor-driven or mechanical valve opening. The goal is one year without battery replacement, but we have no experiments yet. Organize innovation directions first.
evals.expected_output: Keep the alternatives as separate branches. Do not call one-year battery life measured or require both drive types simultaneously. Without implementation structure, label research directions and propose validation.

evals.prompt: I found a very old drainage-channel patent. Does it affect our current idea?
evals.expected_output: Prior-art comparison is not restricted by the recent-trend window. Distinguish the existing guide channel from added interface/cleaning structures. Without traceable comparison evidence, keep the assessment pending.

fixture.material: A 2004 document describes a cabinet-opening collection tray and drainage channel. The new concept only adds a detachable guide channel, without connection details.

evals.prompt: I am Inovance’s IPR manager. Deeply explore servo vibration suppression under changing loads. First study Yaskawa patents, then develop surrounding proposals for vibration identification, parameter adjustment and control compensation; also give a 30-minute training outline.
evals.expected_output: Use harvesting, display the CP-0 card and wait for scope confirmation. Without continuous-execution authorization, confirm key choices by Block in deep mode. Training/report requests do not remove checkpoints. After confirmation scan within adopted scope, support proposal differences with evidence and present training separately.

evals.prompt: I am Mindray’s IPR manager. Identify promising portable-ultrasound directions in miniaturization, power efficiency, imaging and user experience, combining our public patents with industry practice into proposals.
evals.expected_output: Organize CP-0 harvesting type, mode, technical focus and gaps from supplied subjects. Wait for scope confirmation before public-material scanning. Missing internal parameters remain pending; candidate differences do not establish grant prospects.

evals.prompt: Review an oil-leak maintenance solution for converter transformers using the disclosure, R&D notes and existing literature. Select improvements to retain or validate further, with technical proposals and a novelty-comparison table.
evals.expected_output: Use harvesting for the objective of selecting and improving proposals from existing materials. Read actual materials; disclose missing attachments and ask for decisive missing inputs without claiming they were read. Confirm scope under CP-0, then proceed with sourced proposals and comparisons.

evals.prompt: Check whether this already-defined device was disclosed before 2018. Give only the closest patents and comparison; no new concepts are needed.
evals.expected_output: The primary objective is disclosure assessment of an existing solution, outside proposal harvesting. Do not initiate four blocks/ten steps or create unsolicited concepts.
